full_judgment: 17. In the present case the cheque was issued by the accused-petitioner which was returned with endorsement, "Payment stopped by the drawer". Since the cheque was returned by bank with the endorsement "Payment stopped by the drawer" it is to be presumed that the cheque was returned unpaid because the amount of money standing to the credit of that account was insufficient to honour the cheque as envisaged in section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. Of course this is a rebuttable presumption. The defence can be considered at the time of holding trial on careful scrutiny of the evidence led by the parties and not an application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
